goal: Expose the recorded derivation override to the production migration workflow and pass it through every deterministic guard choke point.
prohibited_actions: Do not weaken or bypass any migration, preview, review, evidence, allowlist, ledger, or production gate.
Do not touch database structure or rows.
Do not merge while the production freeze remains active or before the landing controller authorizes it.
assumptions: The guard already implements and records a repeatable VERSION:BASE=NOTE derivation override for prepare, preflight, and assert-bounded.
Production lacks both 20260914061331 and its reissue 20260914075758, so the workflow must carry one recorded override consistently rather than alter the allowed migration set.
stop_conditions: Stop if the repair requires changing guard semantics rather than workflow plumbing.
Stop if any path can apply an override without recording and rechecking it at every production choke point.
Stop if tests or exact-head review identify a weakened fail-closed gate.
